subject: ela
name: English Language Arts
course: Complex Text Structures, Theme & Evidence-Based Essay Writing
title: Grade 4 English Language Arts: Complex Text Structures, Theme & Evidence-Based Essay Writing
overview: Grade 4 English Language Arts immerses students in literary and informational texts, developing close reading comprehension, evidence-based writing, academic vocabulary, and collaborative discourse.
competencies: Read grade-level literary and informational texts with fluency, accuracy, and deep comprehension.
Cite specific textual evidence to substantiate answers, inferences, and central theme analyses.
Write clear, organized opinion, informative, and narrative compositions using standard grammar conventions.
Participate actively in collaborative discussions, expressing ideas clearly and building upon others' contributions.

modules.title: Deep Literary Analysis, Theme & Character Motivations
modules.description: Determining the theme of stories, dramas, and poems from details in the text, and analyzing character reactions to challenges.

topics.title: Theme Development Across Literary Genres
topics.description: Synthesizing character decisions and resolutions to deduce overarching themes.

topics.title: Character Perspective & Structural Elements
topics.description: Contrasting first-person and third-person narrations and analyzing structural elements of prose/poetry/drama.

modules.title: Informational Synthesis & Historical Accounts
modules.description: Analyzing firsthand and secondhand accounts of the same event, integrating information from two texts on the same topic.

topics.title: Firsthand vs. Secondhand Historical Accounts
topics.description: Comparing primary diary entries with secondary textbook narratives for point of view and bias.

topics.title: Multi-Text Synthesis on Science & History Topics
topics.description: Integrating evidence from multiple informational passages to write a cohesive summary.

modules.title: Structured Explanatory & Persuasive Essay Writing
modules.description: Writing multi-paragraph essays with clear central claims, topic sentences, concrete evidence, and academic vocabulary.

topics.title: Opinion Essays with Evidence Citations
topics.description: Writing persuasive compositions with reasons supported by facts, linking phrases, and concluding sections.

topics.title: Explanatory and Informative Research Reports
topics.description: Developing topics with facts, definitions, concrete details, quotations, and formatting features.
